query: Civiqs MRP Trump net approve disapprove

results.content:
Nationally, 35 percent of voters approve of Trump's job performance while 59 percent disapprove as of August 19, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The survey has garnered 124,759 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump was inaugurated for a second term. [...] According to the Civiqs poll, Trump has the highest net approval rating in Wyoming, where 56 percent of voters approve of his performance and 35 disapprove—giving him a net approval rating of +22 when rounding up.

results.content:
According to Civiqs, last updated August 12, Trump's net approval in New Jersey stood at -35%.

New Jersey tilts unfavorable overall. About 65% of New Jersey residents polled currently disapprove of the president's performance.About 30% approve and another 5% did not choose either.

Education: Respondents across all education levels disapprove of Trump’s job performance, with postgraduate at 78%, college graduate at 67% and non-college graduate at 60%. [...] Gender: Roughly two-thirds of women (70%) disapprove of Trump's performance. Men lean unfavorable toward Trump, with 60% disapproving and 35% approving.

results.title: A new low for Trump approval rating triggered by ongoing war with Iran

results.content:
AP News' poll from the Associated Press-NORC Center for Public Affairs Research says Trump's approval rating stands at 66% against and 33% for him as of July 23.
 Fox News' poll says Trump stands at 61% against and 39% for as of July 17-20.
 Reuters/Ipsos' poll says Trump stands at 63% disapproval, 33% approval as of Aug. 28-31.
 Civiqs' national polling says Trump stands at 59% against and 36% for with 6% undecided as of Aug. 31. [...] The New York Times averages several other polls daily. Its data says Trump stands at 58% disapproval and 38% approval as of Sept. 1.
 Silver Bulletin's poll shows 58% disapprove and 38.2% approve as of Sept. 1.
 RealClearPolitics averages several other polls.
